outcome: Give the shipped Runner a way to do the journey against a real control plane, because the only thing that drives one today is a test.
non_goals: Do not let the Runner call itself the owner in order to get through
Do not ship a path that reaches a control plane without the enrolment the protocol requires
Do not treat a fake journey as evidence about the real one

transitions.reason: the lifecycle work measured that the function which drives a whole journey has exactly one caller in the repository and it is a test, and that the shipped Runner command wires no control plane at all and refuses to start without asking for the fake. Every journey observed so far was driven by a test process speaking the protocol, which is why the autonomous-resolution capability keeps being recorded as unexercised
the task that measured this defect lands the first edges the rest build on
